verdicts.title: p-torsion elements in local cohomology modules. II
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Lyubeznik conjectured that local cohomology modules of regular rings have finitely many associated primes. We examine this conjecture for polynomial rings over the integers, and record some equational identities that arise from studying special cases.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns Lyubeznik's conjecture on associated primes of local cohomology modules of polynomial rings over integers, with no mention of CNF formulas, term-overlap graphs, resolution width, or proof complexity. It shares only the term 'local cohomology' with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Mixed Hodge structure on local cohomology with support in determinantal varieties
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We employ the inductive structure of determinantal varieties to calculate the mixed Hodge module structure of local cohomology modules with determinantal support. We show that the weight of a simple composition factor is uniquely determined by its support and cohomological degree. As a consequence, we obtain the equivariant structure of the Hodge filtration on each local cohomology module. verdicts.title: Recent advances on the log-rank conjecture in communication complexity
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The log-rank conjecture is one of the fundamental open problems in communication complexity. It speculates that the deterministic communication complexity of any two-party function is equal to the log of the rank of its associated matrix, up to polynomial factors. Despite much research, we still know very little about this conjecture.
